kjv: [Because of] his strength will I wait upon thee (KJV 59:9)
mine: O my Strength, I will watch for you
note: MT 'uzzo "his strength"; I follow many Hebrew mss, LXX and Targum in reading 'uzzi "my strength", matching the refrain in v.18; the KJV keeps "his" and supplies "because of".

kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me (KJV 59:10)
mine: My God in his steadfast love will meet me
note: yeqaddemeni "will come to meet me"; 1611 "prevent" meant "go before, anticipate", the reverse of its modern sense "hinder".
